checks: All candidate pins match. Isolated replay passed all 1,280 original-instruction cases across 256 flag-byte values and indices 0, 1, 2, 3, and 0xFFFFFFFF.

The invalid-index cases with null context returned zero without context reads, supporting the unsigned index guard before dereference. Valid-index cases support base load from context+16, byte load at base+index*60+35, and result 1 exactly when (byte & 6)==6.
The 38-byte body boundary [0x7DDE,0x7E04) and exclusion of adjacent 0x7E04 are consistent with the pinned original body. No helper or function interception is present.
limitations: The two-bit predicate's hardware or product-level meaning is provisional. Invalid indices beyond the tested sentinels, pointer validity, concurrency, and caller behavior are not established.
No canonical admission or whole-image completeness is claimed.
